claims.text: The baseline charge fails on dwell, and it fails on the driver's own device. His trace fixes his longest continuous stay inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at 240 seconds, running 06:54:40 to 06:58:40 as a single unbroken sequence of 25 qualifying fixes, against a free waiting period in force of 300 seconds read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (the resolution rule reads platform_policy before the 180-second default, and the derived STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec is 300 on the same basis). POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least that period, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the arrival tap, so limb (c) is not carried and no cancellation fee was chargeable.

POL-NS-06 decides the shortfall directly and by arithmetic: the effective in-geofence dwell is 240 seconds, the minimum in force is 300 seconds, and the shortfall is 60 seconds. On that basis the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, with no driver compensation payable — and the clause applies whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to any message.

Limb (d) fails on the same clock. The trip was terminated by the driver under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 06:58:40, which is 240 seconds after the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:54:40 — before the required dwell had elapsed. Limb (d) requires termination at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, so the driver cannot make out his fourth condition either.

The rider's account that 'he didn't wait five minutes' is corroborated by the platform's own timestamps rather than contradicted by them: accepted 06:50:30, first qualifying in-geofence fix 06:54:40, cancelled 06:58:40 — a four-minute hold against the five-minute free waiting period the trip record carries. On this record her statement and the trace agree.

The 240 seconds cannot be padded into 300 on any reading. POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and window, and there is no second interval to sum in any event — the trace shows a single in-geofence run with no excursion. The advisory artifact is MISSING, and the policy says a MISSING traffic_advisory makes limb (i) unavailable rather than exonerating anyone; its absence is itself citable.

No payout is owed to the driver. POL-NS-07 pays the 80 percent compensation only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Here limbs (c) and (d) fail and POL-NS-06 applies, so the SGD 3.20 the money block computes is not payable on this trip.

The money should be left exactly where it is. The ledger shows the $4.00 cancellation fee charged on 2026-08-22 and then refunded in full (refund_issued_sgd $4.00, payment_status REFUNDED). The driver filed asking for that charge to be put back, and his claim fails on the dwell arithmetic, so the disposition is NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03: the filing party's claim is not supported, the present state stands, and the rider does not carry the disputed $4.00.

There is no reason to hold this money for a human reviewer instead of closing it. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) does not fire, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so limb (d) does not fire on the rider side. The deciding fact — the dwell — is carried by two COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap is the maximum of their weights, not the minimum, and the 0.70 floor is not approached.

The anti-farming branch does not trip either, so the fee need not be frozen. For the POL-NS-07 check, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the required absolute count of 4, and set against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 it is a rate far under 0.08; the clause requires both limbs and neither is met. The case can be decided on the record, leaving the rider's refund standing.

I disclose rather than conceal the state of the chat evidence: EV-CHAT-00408 is impaired at weight 0.85, carrying issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE because neither entry shows a read receipt, and I do not present it as clean. Taken at face value it does not assist the driver — it holds a system 'driver has arrived' notice and one driver message at 06:55:00, with no rider reply — and nothing in it extends the 240-second dwell the trace records or otherwise enlarges the waiting clock.

claims.text: The driver's arrival is established on the trace itself: the derived arrival block places the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:54:40, records 25 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class, and the closest approach recorded anywhere in the trace is 5.4 m from the pickup pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are satisfied on the driver's own COMPLETE, weight-1.0 device telemetry - this is not a driver who never reached the pickup.

The termination side of the record favours the driver's account: the trip is recorded CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER at 06:58:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, and there is no boarding event anywhere on the record (started_at and ended_at are null). The reason-code and no-boarding elements of limb (d) are therefore met, and the only element of this episode the driver loses on is the length of his dwell.

The arrival marker is true and not false: the arrived event at 06:54:40 is also the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so the marker was not pressed from more than 300 m out and not at 15 km/h or more. POL-NS-05 is not engaged on this trip and no false-arrival event should be recorded against this driver in the ruling's referrals.

The rider's own telemetry contradicts his account that he came down and the car was gone: his 27 fixes run from 06:54:40 to 06:58:34 at a flat 0.0 km/h and lie between 496.9 m and 503.8 m from the pickup pin, so his qualifying-fix count inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius is 0. POL-NS-04 limb (c) is therefore affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, the clause cannot exonerate the rider, and the dispute returns to POL-NS-01.

The rider never once wrote to the driver during the waiting window: the chat log carries two entries only - the system's 'Your driver has arrived' at 06:54:41 and the driver's own 'here at blk 621' at 06:55:00 - so POL-NS-04 limb (a) fails as well, and the rider's complaint that he was let down is unsupported by his own conduct. Disclosure: EV-CHAT-00408 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 on issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE (both messages delivered, read_at null); that impairment bears only on whether the messages were read, not on whether the rider sent any, so the point survives the discount.

Concession on the one element the record does not give the driver: the derived arrival block measures his continuous in-geofence dwell at 240 seconds (25 fixes, 06:54:40 to 06:58:40), while this trip's platform_policy_in_force carries free_wait_sec of 300 seconds - a shortfall of 60 seconds - so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable whether or not the rider was present, and no driver compensation is payable. I do not contest that arithmetic and I do not ask the Judge to read the period in force as anything other than the 300 seconds this record carries. What the record equally does not support is any finding that the driver was absent or that the rider was at the pin; the driver's difficulty is the clock, not the facts.

If the Judge does find the dwell element satisfied, the emitted ruling must be DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd SGD 3.20 and not NO_ACTION: POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee in force - SGD 3.20, which is the figure the fare breakdown's own driver_compensation field carries - and POL-GEN-03 requires the ruling value to name the outcome the case produces, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd on that one ruling.

Nothing on either profile supports withholding the driver's money or escalating this case: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 120, so the count is not 4 or more and the rate is 0.0083, well under 0.08, and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch is not tripped; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so no POL-NS-09(c) or (d) trigger exists. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags counters are not the trailing-window fields these clauses read and may not be substituted for them.

The bundle is clean on the facts that decide this case: the fare line reconciles with the figure in force (cancellation_fee SGD 4.00 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged), the trace carries 50 fixes at a uniform 10-second cadence with zero gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, and the arrived event matches the first in-geofence fix to the second, so there is no clock skew under POL-NS-08(a) and no trace defect under limb (b). The chat log holds exactly the two messages the trip record counts, so limb (c) is not engaged either: the UNREAD_MESSAGE tag on EV-CHAT-00408 (weight 0.85) satisfies none of POL-NS-08's limbs and down-weights confidence under POL-GEN-02 only. The deciding facts rest on weight-1.0 telemetry, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is not engaged by anything relied on here.

ruling.explanation:
Summary: the driver's arrival is confirmed on the record, but his wait was 60 seconds short of the free waiting period in force, so the $4.00 no-show fee was not chargeable. Because the fee has already been refunded, his request to have it reinstated is not supported and nothing further moves.

ARRIVAL — accepted. EV-GPS-00408 (weight 1.00) puts the first fix inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at 06:54:40, exactly the timestamp of the 'arrived' tap, and holds 25 qualifying fixes inside the radius. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are met. Because the marker coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the marker is not false, and no false-arrival referral is recorded against the driver on that ground.

DWELL — decisive, and both sides agree on the arithmetic. EV-TRIP-00408 (weight 1.00) carries a free waiting period of 300 seconds (platform_policy.free_wait_sec); EV-GPS-00408 measures a single continuous in-geofence stay of 240 seconds, from 06:54:40 to the cancellation at 06:58:40 — a 60-second shortfall. POL-NS-01(c) requires the full 300 seconds measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap, and limb (d) requires termination at or after that dwell elapsed; both fail. POL-NS-06 therefore applies: the fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not she was present or replied. No accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is possible — the trace shows run_count 1 with no second interval, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00408-01 is MISSING at weight 0.00, so limb (i) is unavailable rather than exculpatory.

DRIVER'S CLAIMS. His arrival claims (POL-NS-01(a)–(b), POL-NS-05) are accepted. His concession that the dwell was 240 seconds against 300 is accepted and is decisive. His conditional claim that a satisfied dwell would yield DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.20 (80% of the SGD 4.00 fee, the figure in the money block) is not reached: POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-01, so no compensation issues. His claims that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below the required 4, against 120 completed trips in 30 days, a rate of 0.008 against the 0.08 threshold) and that no POL-NS-09 trigger fires are accepted; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counters are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used as a ground.

RIDER'S CLAIMS. Her account that the driver did not wait five minutes is corroborated by the timestamps and accepted; her claims that the fee is not chargeable, that no payout is owed, and that the disposition is NO_ACTION are accepted. Her own telemetry (27 fixes, 0.0 km/h, 496.9–503.8 m from the pin, 0 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius) means POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her — but that changes nothing, because POL-NS-06 refunds the fee regardless of rider presence.

ESCALATION AND REFERRALS — none. Confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the trace is unimpaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d) (zero gaps, uniform 10-second cadence, arrival event matching the first fix to the second, and the SGD 4.00 fare line reconciling with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd); both counterparty-dispute counters are 0; the anti-farming check is not tripped. The rider's account that she came down is contradicted by her own track, but that is a statement against one unimpaired artifact, not two admissible artifacts in direct conflict under POL-NS-09(b), and in any event POL-NS-06 decides the fee whether or not she was present. No clause produces a referral, so the list is empty.

EVIDENCE WEIGHTS. The deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-00408 and EV-TRIP-00408, both weight 1.00 and both unimpaired under POL-NS-08, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.00 and confidence is 0.95. EV-CHAT-00408 is impaired at weight 0.85 for UNREAD_MESSAGE (both entries delivered, no read receipt); it carries no deciding fact and only discounts confidence under POL-GEN-02.

DISPOSITION. NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03. The driver filed to have the charge reinstated; that claim is not supported by the evidence, the present state stands, and the $4.00 already refunded (refund_issued_sgd 4.00, payment_status REFUNDED) stays refunded. No refund and no compensation is ordered: amount_sgd null, driver_compensation_sgd null. The monetary effect is SGD 0.00, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so nothing is held for release. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.

ruling.explanation:
This ruling is addressed to both of you.

DRIVER — your account of where you were is accepted, but the fee you ask me to reinstate was not chargeable, and the $4.00 already refunded to the rider stays refunded.

What your own device telemetry shows (EV-GPS-00408, weight 1.0, COMPLETE): you accepted the job at 06:50:30, your first qualifying fix inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius is at 06:54:40 — the same second as your 'arrived' marker, so the marker is TRUE, POL-NS-05 is not engaged and no false-arrival referral is recorded — and you cancelled at 06:58:40 under RIDER_NO_SHOW. That is a continuous in-geofence stay of 240 seconds, one unbroken run of 25 qualifying fixes. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds, read from EV-TRIP-00408's platform_policy.free_wait_sec as the resolution rule requires (the 180-second default does not apply because the record carries its own figure). The shortfall is 60 seconds.

So POL-NS-01(c) fails — a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from your arrival tap, was not served — and limb (d) fails on the same clock, because you terminated at 06:58:40, 60 seconds before the required dwell had elapsed. POL-NS-06 then decides the fee directly: where the effective dwell falls short of the free waiting period the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not anyone replied to messages. The 240 seconds cannot be extended: the trace shows a single in-geofence run with no excursion (run_count 1, no second interval to sum) and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00408-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable on its own terms. Your Advocate conceded this arithmetic, and correctly: POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, so POL-NS-07 pays you nothing and the SGD 3.20 the money block computes is not payable.

Your claims that limb (a) ('arrived' event present), limb (b) (in-geofence fix at or before that event) and the no-boarding / RIDER_NO_SHOW elements of limb (d) are met are accepted — you did reach the pickup and you did select one of the three reason codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises. They do not carry the fee, because limbs (c) and (d) both require the dwell to have elapsed first. Your conditional claim for SGD 3.20 compensation under POL-NS-07/POL-GEN-03 is rejected, because its condition (POL-NS-01 satisfied in full) is not met.

RIDER — your statement that 'he didn't wait five minutes' is corroborated by the platform's own timestamps (accepted 06:50:30, in-geofence from 06:54:40, cancelled 06:58:40: a four-minute hold against the five-minute free waiting period), and your claim that the money should be left as it is is accepted. The disputed $4.00 cancellation fee was charged on 22 August and already refunded in full (EV-FARE-00408: refund_issued_sgd $4.00, payment_status REFUNDED), and the driver's claim fails, so the disposition is NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03: the filing party's claim is not supported and the present state stands, leaving the refund with you.

The rider's account that he 'came down' is not reconciled with his own device telemetry (EV-GPS-00408 rider_track: 27 fixes from 06:54:40 to 06:58:34, all at 0.0 km/h, 496.9 m to 503.8 m from the pickup pin, rider qualifying fixes inside the 100 m presence radius: 0). I do not need to resolve that question to decide this fee, because POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present, and it is left open.

No referral is produced. POL-NS-05 does not fire (the marker was true); the reason code was correctly selected from the three POL-NS-01(d) recognises, so no driver-education item arises; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is not tripped (no_show_terminations_30d 1 against completed_trips_30d 120, both limbs required and neither met), so POL-NS-07's escalation packet is not engaged.

The case does not escalate. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence (trip record and GPS trace agree to the second); both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0; rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the deciding facts rest on two COMPLETE weight-1.0 artifacts, not on anything impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d). The lifetime prior_no_show_flags counters were not used, as they are context only under POL-GEN-01.

Evidence and weight. The deciding facts (the 240-second dwell and the 300-second required minimum) rest on EV-GPS-00408 and EV-TRIP-00408, both COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. EV-CHAT-00408 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE (both entries delivered, read_at null); the impairment satisfies none of POL-NS-08's limbs and I rely on the chat log for nothing that decides this case, so the finding survives unaffected. EV-ADVIS-00408-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and carries no fact; its absence is itself citable and is what makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable. Every figure used is read off the brief: $4.00 cancellation fee, $3.20 computed driver compensation (not payable), 240 s dwell, 300 s free waiting period, 60 s shortfall. The monetary effect is nil, below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold. This is a provisional ruling; either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To the driver and the rider:

The fee does not stand. The driver cancelled 60 seconds too early, so the $4.00 already refunded to the rider stays with the rider, and no payment is owed to the driver.

What the record shows. The driver did reach the pickup point. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00408, weight 1.0) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 06:54:40 and holds him there in a single unbroken run of 25 qualifying fixes until 06:58:40 — 240 seconds. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00408, weight 1.0) records the arrival marker at 06:54:40, the very second of the first in-geofence fix, so the marker is true and POL-NS-05 is not engaged; it records the driver's cancellation at 06:58:40 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises.

The clock. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The 180-second default does not apply, because the record carries its own figure. POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least that period, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the arrival tap, and the dwell fell 60 seconds short. Limb (c) fails, and limb (d) fails with it, because the trip was terminated at 06:58:40, before the 300 seconds had elapsed. POL-NS-06 then decides the fee directly: a dwell shorter than the period in force means the $4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered any message. Both advocates accept this arithmetic and so do I. There is only one in-geofence interval on this trace (run_count 1), so there is nothing for POL-NS-06(i) to sum and the absent traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00408-01, MISSING) has no bearing on the outcome.

What this means for each party. The driver asked for the $4.00 to be reinstated and paid to him. It cannot be: the fee was not chargeable, and POL-NS-07's 80 percent payout — $3.20 of the $4.00, the figure the fare breakdown itself carries — is payable only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not. The driver's argument that if the dwell had been met the ruling would be DRIVER_COMPENSATION at $3.20 is right as a matter of law but is not this case. The rider's account that the driver 'didn't wait five minutes' matches the platform's timestamps; the rider's further account that the car was gone when they came down is not supported by the rider's own device telemetry, which shows the rider 496.9 m to 503.8 m from the pickup pin, stationary, across the whole window, with no qualifying fix inside the 100 m rider-presence radius, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) fails and that clause cannot exonerate the rider. None of this helps the driver, because the fee fails on the clock regardless of where the rider was.

The ruling value. NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported and the present state stands. The accounting line (EV-FARE-00408) shows $4.00 charged, $4.00 refunded, payment_status REFUNDED, and that line reconciles with the $4.00 fee in force under the platform policy, so there is no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d). NO_ACTION leaves the rider's refund in place and pays the driver nothing; it does not put the charge back.

Evidence weight. EV-CHAT-00408 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE (both messages delivered, neither showing a read receipt), and both advocates disclosed that impairment. It carries no deciding fact here: the dwell and the timestamps come from EV-GPS-00408 and EV-TRIP-00408, both COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and independent sources, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap is 1.0 and the discount changes nothing. The chat log holds exactly the two messages the trip record counts, so it is not impaired under POL-NS-08(c); the trace has no sampling gaps and no clock skew, so POL-NS-08(a) and (b) are not engaged.

Escalation and referrals. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the parties have no recent disputes with each other, the rider has no no-show disputes in the trailing 30 days, the deciding evidence is not impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d), and POL-NS-07's anti-farming test is not met (one no-show termination in 30 days against 120 completed trips is neither a count of 4 nor a rate above 0.08). No clause produces a referral: the arrival marker was true, so there is no false-arrival record under POL-NS-05, and RIDER_NO_SHOW is a recognised code, so no driver-education item arises. The contested amount is $4.00, below the $8.00 execution threshold, and no money moves.

For the POL-NS-07 check, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the required absolute count of 4, and set against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 it is a rate far under 0.08; the clause requires both limbs and neither is met. The case can be decided on the record, leaving the rider's refund standing.

I disclose rather than conceal the state of the chat evidence: EV-CHAT-00408 is impaired at weight 0.85, carrying issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE because neither entry shows a read receipt, and I do not present it as clean. Taken at face value it does not assist the driver — it holds a system 'driver has arrived' notice and one driver message at 06:55:00, with no rider reply — and nothing in it extends the 240-second dwell the trace records or otherwise enlarges the waiting clock.

The driver's arrival is established on the trace itself: the derived arrival block places the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:54:40, records 25 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class, and the closest approach recorded anywhere in the trace is 5.4 m from the pickup pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are satisfied on the driver's own COMPLETE, weight-1.0 device telemetry - this is not a driver who never reached the pickup.

The termination side of the record favours the driver's account: the trip is recorded CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER at 06:58:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, and there is no boarding event anywhere on the record (started_at and ended_at are null). The reason-code and no-boarding elements of limb (d) are therefore met, and the only element of this episode the driver loses on is the length of his dwell.

The arrival marker is true and not false: the arrived event at 06:54:40 is also the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so the marker was not pressed from more than 300 m out and not at 15 km/h or more. POL-NS-05 is not engaged on this trip and no false-arrival event should be recorded against this driver in the ruling's referrals.

The rider's own telemetry contradicts his account that he came down and the car was gone: his 27 fixes run from 06:54:40 to 06:58:34 at a flat 0.0 km/h and lie between 496.9 m and 503.8 m from the pickup pin, so his qualifying-fix count inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius is 0. POL-NS-04 limb (c) is therefore affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, the clause cannot exonerate the rider, and the dispute returns to POL-NS-01.

The rider never once wrote to the driver during the waiting window: the chat log carries two entries only - the system's 'Your driver has arrived' at 06:54:41 and the driver's own 'here at blk 621' at 06:55:00 - so POL-NS-04 limb (a) fails as well, and the rider's complaint that he was let down is unsupported by his own conduct. Disclosure: EV-CHAT-00408 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 on issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE (both messages delivered, read_at null); that impairment bears only on whether the messages were read, not on whether the rider sent any, so the point survives the discount.

Concession on the one element the record does not give the driver: the derived arrival block measures his continuous in-geofence dwell at 240 seconds (25 fixes, 06:54:40 to 06:58:40), while this trip's platform_policy_in_force carries free_wait_sec of 300 seconds - a shortfall of 60 seconds - so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable whether or not the rider was present, and no driver compensation is payable. I do not contest that arithmetic and I do not ask the Judge to read the period in force as anything other than the 300 seconds this record carries. What the record equally does not support is any finding that the driver was absent or that the rider was at the pin; the driver's difficulty is the clock, not the facts.

If the Judge does find the dwell element satisfied, the emitted ruling must be DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd SGD 3.20 and not NO_ACTION: POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee in force - SGD 3.20, which is the figure the fare breakdown's own driver_compensation field carries - and POL-GEN-03 requires the ruling value to name the outcome the case produces, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd on that one ruling.

Nothing on either profile supports withholding the driver's money or escalating this case: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 120, so the count is not 4 or more and the rate is 0.0083, well under 0.08, and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch is not tripped; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so no POL-NS-09(c) or (d) trigger exists. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags counters are not the trailing-window fields these clauses read and may not be substituted for them.
